senses.gloss:
√guh (gū́hati [745c]; jugū́ha [793f],
juguhé; ághukṣat [916, 155]; gūḍhá
[222^3]; gū́hitum; -gúhya). hide; gūḻhá,
hidden, 76^15.
+ apa, hide (trans.) away from, w. abl.,
85^14; put away, get rid of, 77^1.

gúh, f. hiding-place; instr. guhā́: used as
adv. gúhā [1112e], in secret. [√guh.]

guhyaka, m. one of a class of demigods,
who, like the Yakshas, wait on Kubera,
god of wealth, and, dwelling in mountain
caverns (guhā), keep his treasures. [so
named from their living in caverns or
hidden places: 1222.]
